title: Interdependencies between Eastern Partnership countries: Security
contributors: I. Gazizullin (Ukrainian Institute for Public Policy)
descriptions: The data provide an overview about security trainings that involve two or more members of the EU´s Eastern Partnership policy - that is Belarus, Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Moldova. The data set relies on information retrieved from the websites of the countries´ ministry of foreign affairs and from news papers.
